claim_scope: Exact support topology, unique invariant distribution, regularity and stationary second moment for a constant-step full-Haar-basis forward-difference optimizer on centered isotropic quadratics in real dimension at least two.

scientific_limitations_and_integrity.assumptions: Noiseless isotropic quadratic; i.i.d. independent Haar orthogonal full bases; fixed positive finite-difference distance and constant normalized step strictly between zero and two; dimension at least two.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: The full theorem is proved analytically. A reproducible standard-library checker supplies exact finite rational checks and numerical diagnostics, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.unproved: No assertion for arbitrary nonlinear or anisotropic objectives, partial or non-Haar bases, dimension one, finite-time confidence coverage, or endpoint step sizes. Publication priority for the underlying sphere sumset identity may overlap older geometric literature.

title: Reentrant stationary-support topology in Haar-basis zeroth-order descent
